name: Coding-Agent Evaluation and Lessons
description: A Python/AWS pipeline that evaluates AI coding-agent sessions, identifies failure patterns in tool-use cycles, clusters recurring mistakes, and generates corrective lessons. Approved lessons are validated with A/B replay experiments and written back into agent memory.

name: Curiosity Exploration
description: Semantic graph analysis for comparing patterns of human exploration in Chain Free Association and Semantic Fluency tasks. The companion repository supports the study of cross-task exploration styles.

name: Persona Heuristic Mapping
description: An evaluation pipeline that translates persona descriptions through psychometric inventories into measurable trait profiles. Tournament protocols and behavior metrics test whether persona conditioning produces consistent shifts across prompts and model variants.

name: Developer Search and MCP Integration
description: Repository and documentation search combining LLM-expanded keyword retrieval with document summaries. An MCP service enabled Cursor to generate OpenSearch queries and surface keyword-usage summaries across code and internal documentation.

name: Legal Retrieval and Entailment
description: Retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines for large case corpora, including segmentation, indexing, query-focused retrieval, and citation-grounded answer synthesis. Evaluation tracks faithfulness, citation coverage, and entailment errors.

name: Grammar-Constrained Code Generation
description: A constraint layer for transformer code generation that filters token choices using a formal grammar and allowed constructs. Experiments examine constraint strictness, syntactic validity, and exact-match behavior.

name: Natural Language Action Legality
context: Air Force Research Laboratory | Machine Learning Internship, 2023
description: A system that maps natural-language utterances into structured actions and determines whether they are permitted by a ruleset and the current game state.
